notes.title: December 2024
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9760652e58f128f59776eef46c2b84e66f99236b.jpg[/img]

As the year draws to a close, here’s a quick rundown. Before you tune out, let me present the agenda—maybe one of the topics will catch your interest, and you can jump straight to it:

1. **Priest Simulator**  
2. **Mercyful Flames**  
3. **Taxi Simulator**  
4. **Your Principal**  

[h1]Priest Simulator[/h1]

Our most recognized franchise so far is keeping us busy:

The **Vampire Show** has left Early Access. However, we’ve already received feedback about some messed-up lipsync and issues with the final raid not registering correctly. We’ve fixed the first problem, and we’re working on the second. A patch is on its way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

We’ve released *Her Ghost*, a DLC for *Vampire Show*, offering about an hour of new gameplay. Some of you may remember that we declared the game finished months ago, but for various reasons, the launch was delayed. Sure, any game can be endlessly improved, so we added a few more cards to the Trello board. Plus, we wanted to experiment with creating DLC, so we decided to add new content roughly on the scale of *Heavy Duty*. Big thanks to everyone who purchased it.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/a600c086e2e6a9d8b55b48b80c2334850957a4b6.jpg[/img]

We also made the soundtrack available some time ago. You can listen to it on Spotify or YouTube. The music video for the standout track *Legion* is doing pretty well at festivals:

- Winner: Best Polish Animated Music Video at PL Music Video Awards 2024  
- Winner: *Black Horse of Music Videos* at Ars Independent 2024  
- Semi-finalist: Azyl Shorts 2024  

It was also officially selected for:  
Animakom Fest 2024,  
Żubroffka 2024 (Music Video category),  
Animest 2024,  
Splat!FilmFest 2024,  
Grand Video Awards 2024 (Music Video category),  
Offeliada 2024,  
Linoleum 2024.  

Watch it here:  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMop-7BM4ds  

That’s not all the news from the *Priest* universe. We’ve been working for months on the next installment, *Wolf Moon*. It continues threads from the previous games but takes them in a very different direction. It’s a low-poly action RPG inspired by MOBAs and *Vampire Survivors*. We intended to release the Steam page this year, but it’s not yet up to our standards.

[h1]Mercyful Flames[/h1]

We’ve really gone all out on this one. Last year, we made the tough decision to rework the game completely—a decision that was challenging but ultimately necessary. The original concept of a card-based RPG might resurface in a future project, but not here. *Mercyful Flames* always had great atmosphere but struggled with the transition of our physical designs into a digital format. 

This time, we went all in, inspired by a friend’s comment: “I’d buy a *Priest* game that’s just cutscenes.” While it’s an oversimplification, it nudged us toward creating a minimalist, gameplay-light experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9f43649f9c317bbbe19503dc7c6f5949339f975b.jpg[/img]

The game is going through what feels like its hundredth iteration. I admit I’ve gone a bit obsessive, tweaking every little detail. We keep adding minor dialogues or effects to enhance the illusion of a living world. The game is divided into dozens of “scenes,” and polishing one often makes others look subpar in comparison. At that point, we have to even things out, one way or another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/Mercyful_Flames_The_Witches/

As with *Vulgator*, we’ve collaborated with acclaimed Polish artists. This time, we worked with *Alembik*, a duo comprising Robert and Michał. You might know Michał from *Owls Woods Graves*, *Over the Voids*, and *Mgła* (live). They composed the soundtrack, which will also be available as a standalone album on streaming platforms.

[h1]Taxi Simulator[/h1]

Now for our biggest project. We’ve been dedicating our lives to this one and regularly post devlogs about its progress. The game has a completely different vibe from anything we’ve done before—less experimental, more craftsmanship. This time, the title isn’t some ironic twist; it’s exactly what it says.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159390/Taxi_Simulator/

**Your Principal** is temporarily on hold by mutual agreement with the publisher. We’ll return to it next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176330/Your_Principal/

Apart from these titles, we’re also working on a port—or rather, a remaster—of a certain hit, but we’re not revealing any details yet.

By the way, you might have read rumors that we’re quitting game development to start selling weapons. Some reliable Polish media outlets got their facts and companies mixed up. I won’t bother denying it because it works in our favor.

notes.title: Micropatch
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

Another cold patch flies in today, fixing small bugs. We're not getting lazy, we're fixing, we're working, so check out the list of changes below. 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where if you load the game on the "Drive home" task, you cannot drive the Polonez away (you cannot complete the game). 
[*] The translation of cold fruit distillate in Turkish has been changed to the correct one (it was Chinese before xD).
[*] The name of alpha-amylase in the Russian language has been aligned with the UI.
[*] Fixed the closing screen in the Italian version to show the correct subtitles (previously it was the same text everywhere).
[*] The ability to bypass JP in Act 4 after the wood has been blocked. 
[*] Fixed a bug where hovering over the closed door to Quella's room would display a message that the vacuum cleaner was missing.
[/list]
That's it. It wasn't much, but we realize that these little bugs are always the most annoying. We've fixed everything we can, so feel free to fire up the game and enjoy the gameplay, or at least pretend to enjoy it. If anything, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]Booze[/url] is now on a promo. Thanks for all the reviews and comments. Stay tuned.

notes.title: 24 hours to launch
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,
[/h1]
Remember when the party carried us away, and we postponed the premiere? We don't either, but now there are only the last 24 hours left. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url] will be the game we've all been dreaming of. The excitement is so high that we forgot to stock up at the liquor store. Today, we'll tell you a bedtime story about our dear friend - Doctor Professor, which might give you nightmares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/c2377005b685791850e4b79c20346f5a8652c884.jpg[/img]

Doctor Professor, from a young age, had a passion for science and peculiar number sequences. He earned his doctoral title through education at a prestigious university. Boozy parties until dawn, beer pong, strip spin the bottle, and flirting with ladies – that wasn't his world. He much preferred tinkering with sheets of metal and gadgets, to which he had a strange fondness. Days spent on inventions, numerous failures, or an annoying roommate didn't deter the scientist from his life project. Until the day everything went to hell.

In daylight, as if nothing was amiss, the roommate stumbled into the room, drunk as fuck. He rambled about UFOs, vampires, and hamsters. Who knows what he was talking about. A day like any other, but suddenly, he grabbed Professor's favorite gadget. That was the last straw. This event traumatized the poor guy for life. He left all his belongings and projects in his hole, then headed to the bar around the corner. Drowning his sorrows, he pondered the meaning of his life when suddenly a gray-haired gentleman joined him.

Out of nowhere, he came up with an idea for the coldest vodka in the world and claimed he only needed to find a desperate, crazy scientist to help him in this nefarious plan. And so, they became drinking buddies and more.

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url], you'll learn how the friendship between these two unfolded – whether it blossomed or took a different turn. See you in 24 hours, so get your happy faces ready for the premiere. Take care.

notes.title: 2 days to launch
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

In two days (December 13th) we'll be launching the full version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url]. Time is ticking away and we continue to slog through the game, staying awake for the second night in a row. Today we have a short story that is sure to tug at your heartstrings (or stomach, if you're sipping vodka like us) and make you want to pick up Booze on release day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/ac0d5dca7b7bb173a96ea2dae237f5664302f8dd.jpg[/img]

You've already had the chance to meet the frosty bastard from the motel, but now you'll find out what his life was like before he became a ruthless dick. Everything happens for a reason. It all started to go to shit one spring when Zero-Karoten was just a two-ball snowman and his carrot resembled a peanut. One day, his father went out to get some milk and didn't come back. This would have been nothing unusual, but shortly afterward his mother fell ill with a fever and melted in front of him, leaving Zero-Karoten an orphan.

A teenage, life-damaged Zero-Karoten decides to make his dreams come true and tries out for the role of the snowman in the films Frozen and Tabaluga, but, hell, even with snow magic on his side and a life story from the Got Talent or Top Model lineage, he lost out to other actors dressed as snowmen. What a load of crap. It doesn't take long for him to descend into alcoholism and move up the hill, where he opens the shabby motel "La Sorpresa". 

As the years pass, the snowman becomes increasingly bizarre, drowning his daily sorrows in vodka and cursing his life as a miserable martyr. Then, in the motel "La Sorpresa", Jerry and Doctor Professor appear, who seem to be able to change his life. Here a thought is born - he must get the coldest vodka in the world no matter what. Not to drink it (although he probably does), but to be able to leave this boarded-up hole and start a new life somewhere else. 

That's how the character of our weird snowman, Zero-Karoten, was born. We'll see you tomorrow in the final devlog before the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url]. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Let's make moonshine!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url] is just around the corner, and today we enter the secret world of moonshine making and our secret mechanics. The information contained herein may prove essential to your survival in the winter motel 'La Sorpresa', but we recommend that you consult a psychiatrist or pharmacist before you begin, as improperly prepared alcohol can risk a massive hangover or death. Take notes and be prepared for a dose of mystical moonshine knowledge from Jerry's basement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/0c3e3de6d0f87f8b83249cfd3f249f76bc7c2951.jpg[/img]

Making moonshine is not difficult. Of course, if we're talking about the usual piss you can find in any liquor store, but here we're making vodka out of frozen cacti. What can go wrong? Well, just about anything.

Let's start at the beginning. You can't make something out of nothing, so let's start by gathering the right plants to make a drink with divine properties. It will please more than one drunkard outside the shop. You can find the seedlings near the motel, but it's a bit of a walk, really.... Who planted them?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/saSGVK9.gif[/img]

Once you've dug up some herbs with your shovel, the fun begins. In Jerry's moonshine workshop, you have a whole range of messed-up equipment at your disposal. Pick a recipe from the board and follow the instructions - just don't get the proportions wrong or it'll all go to trash.

We start by placing the jug under the crusher, into which we place the appropriate amount of pre-harvested crops, then turn the crank and the magic happens. Once we've processed our ingredients, it's time to strain them and move the jug to the fermentation stand. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WN8taZ3.gif[/img]

This is the moment to add the yeast and other ingredients. Switch on the fermenter and you're done! Just kidding. Now comes the hardest part. Keep an eye on the temperature gauge and keep it in the right position or your whole elaborate plan will be in tatters. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IK46iXO.gif[/img]

If by some miracle you make it this far, congratulations on your success. Go ahead, bottle your life's work, and brag about it on Insta for a few likes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dUKt4M7.gif[/img]

The full version of the game will be released on [b]December 13[/b], allowing you to try your hand at creating a variety of spirits. We hope you find this insight into the secrets of moonshine making more interesting than the evening news on TV. Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]wishlist[/url] and stay tuned.

notes.title: Welcome to the madhouse
notes.content:
[h1]Hi.[/h1]

Today, we're going to introduce you to a few of the characters who will be playing first fiddle in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b][/url]. Grab your favorite glass (in excessive quantities, of course), and let's get started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/0c66bf0103c9bfbb7205d8e02cf71e70357438bd.png[/img]

In front of you - the best and only [b]Quella[/b], a famous reporter and influencer. She's had some not-so-successful reports to her credit, but that doesn't stop her from taking on new challenges. She arrives in La Sorpresa for a holiday (to be honest, it was a forced leave from work), but she has no idea what valuable material she will be able to capture there. Check out her [url=https://www.instagram.com/quella_official_/]instagram account[/url]. She definitely needs more followers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/a16b91b09f733b3e8d35583755a5fd596bf04c06.png[/img]

Moonshiner by vocation, visionary, creator of the world's coldest vodka, [b]Jerry[/b] - not a very pleasant guy, stubbornly defending his ideas. At first glance, he may resemble a typical tipsy uncle at Christmas. Indeed, he does have something in common with him - a penchant for his alcohol production, uninteresting chatter about completely irrelevant topics, and an empathy akin to Karoten. Yes, Zero-Karoten.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/0baabad3009ae99e8ca588138ec56f46b6caa3aa.png[/img]

Many question his work (including himself), the genius, the scientist responsible for creating the generator, the [b]Doctor Professor[/b]. He always hopes to receive a Nobel Prize, but it is not entirely clear in what field. On the surface, he is a sensitive, warm-hearted man, but his ambition pushes him in the unfortunate direction of highly alcoholic beverages. You can count on him for many things, but not for things that will save your life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/eb53febe32ee19cec863dd1b685a52e6354ea6fd.png[/img]

Last but not the least. The cold-hearted bastard, owner of La Sorpresa Motel, the crazy Olaf from Frozen... I mean, [b]Zero-Karoten[/b] - nickname: snowman. Created with 0% carrots, 10% awkward humor, 20% snow, and 100% moonshine. For reasons unknown to us (apparently very personal), he will do anything to get the coldest vodka in the world, even if it means sacrificing a few lives. He does what it takes to get what he wants, and he doesn't care what others think of him. A brutal beast? No. Just a snowman.

notes.title: Mysterious motel
notes.content:
[h1]Hi folks.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/cc81d5e0d20d01d765f6675fe9b9d5ed4c788d5e.jpg[/img]

Today we bring you another devlog, this time with an interesting story from the life of a developer. We're going to tell you about one of the most unique locations in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/url][/b], which is a crackling, freezing motel deep in the woods, in the middle of nowhere. Knocked-out residents, a talking snowman and snow served for dinner (let's hope it's not yellow) are just some of what you'll encounter during the worst holiday of your life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/b62b83189daf473cd03751b290a8e8e7da3198a3.jpg[/img]
[h3]From a witness's diary[/h3]
[i]You may be wondering where the name of the motel "La Sorpresa" comes from. Well, it is quite a funny story. Let's start from the beginning. A long, long time ago, when the Cugowski Brothers gave their concert of a lifetime near Grojec and the return buses had already stopped running, the whole idea was born.

Considering the options for getting home, one of the developers said he wouldn't pay too much for a taxi or walk 11 kilometers. Then it appeared on the horizon. A real pizzeria serving the best pizza with pineapple, peach, banana and olives. But how was it going to solve his problem? Well, normally he ordered a pizza to take home. With himself. And that's how the whole idea of the name of the motel in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/][b]Booze Masters[/b][/url] was born out of a feeling for the place. Something beautiful, something amazing.

So when you visit the frosty La Sorpresa Motel, remember that behind the name lies the history and flavor of those unforgettable moments. You may not get pizza there, but you will get drinks to warm the heart[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/896966362bd4d880038abf9d2bdc777bceb061f1.jpg[/img]
The punchline? Evenings can be difficult, but in moments of crisis, you can always count on 'La Sorpresa', both the real one and the one in our game. Coming soon, in the demo, [b]9 October[/b].

Don't forget to follow us on social media, where we'll keep you up to date with news about the game and the upcoming demo release. Thank you for being with us and supporting our production. Without you, our game would not be the same experience. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA]Discord[/url] and add [b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]wishlist[/url].

Stay warm and see you soon.

notes.title: Booze Masters - New Disaster
notes.content:
[h1]What's up.[/h1]

We have news that will shake you more than high-proof spirits. Our game has undergone changes that even we weren't prepared for. We hope it sweeps you off the board until you're breathless. From reliable sources, we know that the refreshed card has prompted sincere expressions of shock and disbelief from you. Why? Warum? Zašto? After all, it was a game about a Polish village and a grumpy moonshiner. It was, but it transformed into "[b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b]." And there were significant reasons for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/5df8664f6fc48a941a5e24e6db22bb291215397a.jpg[/img]

[h3]This isn't just a title change — it's a small bubble of revolution.[/h3]
We're taking you to a frosty land of bubbling brews and honey flows, where you'll experience an unforgettable adventure. Why the leap from summer to winter? We wanted Freezing, which was initially meant as an introduction to the full Booze game, to become a separate tale, not merely a cut chapter from the complete game. However, the project grew to such proportions that we deemed it fitting to name it our flagship. And so, we have two distinct stories within the same universe. You'll soon be able to play one, and as for the other, the teased demo... Well, first, we'll see how much you enjoy [b]Freezing Moonshine[/b].

You'll probably ask: What about Jerry? Well, the moonshiner stays with us, but as an NPC. The grumbler will teach us the secrets of crafting unique spirits. Despite visual and narrative changes, Booze will remain true to its title. The sharp, dark humor has been adapted to the colder setting, and we've spiced up the cringe with a touch of horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/a328d50afe8f6065af2594e1bcd8469030d5f41d.jpg[/img]

We can say that today marks the start of our game's advertising campaign. We're preparing a new teaser for you, along with plenty of screenshots, blog posts, devlogs, videos (keep an eye on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@asmodev666]TikTok Asmo[/url] ;) ), and other surprises. We're giving it our all, undiluted, at a solid 39%. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/d1fc9aa4bd79020132d7a259e76f5edbd1d7fc29.png[/img]

[h2]We truly believe in the success of the production and that it will bring you a lot of joy. [/h2]
Or at least some. We want to provide you with as much absurd humor as possible and let you have fun crafting unique spirits. We'll do our best to give you a comprehensive view of our game development process. If you have any questions, join our Discord, and we'll do our best to address any doubts you may have.

Get your taste buds ready, because [b]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/b] is gearing up for a grand comeback on the stage.

See you and stay warm!

Dear moonshiners, we apologize for disappearing for so long again but don't worry, it's not because of the drinking spree. The main reason is that we will be making some changes to our production. We can't tell you too much at the moment so as not to spoil the surprise, but believe us - it's going to happen!

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
First and foremost, we are getting ready to rebuild our Steam Tab. We're looking forward to updating the descriptions, adding new graphics, and sorting everything out from A to Z. The concept has changed a bit, we're going in a different - hopefully better - direction - so there's something to look forward to! notes.title: This is not a moonshine simulator
notes.content:
[h1]Hi folks.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/805a2995ee3abdbe055b5bd024455d810fd90cd3.jpg[/img]

Booze, with a slight twist (about which more in a moment), is another game that, after years of messing around, we can finally release. Well, what is delayed is not lost.

[h3]The story of the origin of the title is hardly dramatic[/h3]
We will probably come up with some interesting anecdotes one day, but the truth is as dry as dust. I've written about this before with both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950620/Priest_Simulator/]Priest Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/Mercyful_Flames/]Mercyful Flames[/url]. The delay is because we are testing our game. And it turns out that the game doesn't entertain us the way we intended. So we improve it and test it again...and we'll keep doing that until we die. With every game, always. If we release some shit, it's because #weenjoyitnow, not because we don't want to work anymore. There are a billion games out there that are worth playing, and if we're going to compete with them for your time, we're going to have to do a little bit of work, mate.

[h3]So what have we screwed up this time? [/h3]
If you played the demo, you'll know that Booze is a bit too much like a simulator. Not a serious one like Goat or Flight, but one where you walk around and click on models from the asset store, and the game happens by itself. Not that gameplay-sterile simulators are some kind of entertainment scrapheap, because I don't think so at all, as the tribute list on our developer page shows. The problem is that we are the LAST studio in the world that should be working on simulators because we are simply not competent. We've done a lot of research, and seriously, we know what's going on in the production of various beverages, but we're not interested in faithfully reproducing the turning of the taps and the dosing of yeast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/683b05c56f03286f29f94aee0da92e058977f1a8.png[/img]

[h3]The lie has no legs[/h3]
At a certain stage of production, we managed to convince ourselves that a casual crossover game makes us happy, but... the lie has no legs. As players, we can appreciate simulators, but as developers, we feel unsatisfied. Of course, we need to be stimulated by fantastic ideas, so the right way for us is to stuff hundreds of grotesque plot situations and mechanical solutions that distort realism into the game.

Booze Master had an imbalance when it came to its simulator/economy ratio. There was too much routine woven through the processes of growing crops and making moonshine, and not enough fun resulting from challenges, exploration, and absurd quirks. Weirdness that, in the end, may alienate the purists, but which, in our opinion, makes the game simply fun: addictive, and enjoyable. Our mission is for Booze to deliver backend entertainment, which includes standard gamification for good measure. More challenges, more missions, more rewards, more finds, more twists of fate, less screwing. Getting these proportions right is not particularly difficult. It is, however, time-consuming. Someone has to do the job, and it is us.

What is the advantage? [b]Booze will entertain.[/b]
What is the disadvantage? [b]Booze will not teach.[/b]

notes.title: Is this a Sandbox?
notes.content:
Hi there. I got the question mentioned in the title.

It seems to me that the definition of the sandbox is too flexible for me to give a very brief answer. However, I will try to show where things stand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/368f6e12ed83f7daf91e98bc65b67e7a23ad3673.png[/img]

The game area is divided into three areas. Each area is dedicated to one type of beverage, which means that the map is divided into zones of booze, wine, and beer. As you may have guessed or may remember from the demo, at the start we have access to only one of them. The ultimate goal, however, is to remove all boundaries and have complete freedom of movement all over the terrain. According to this, you will have two Berlin walls set up in the game, which you take down at roughly equal intervals, that is, after dealing with the first and second 30% of the main plot.

Most of the time you'll be running between workshops and crops; so we're not much different from farmer games in this area. We have this weird habit, which may be harmful, of adding a new feature to almost every quest. It results in ending the game with unlocked activities and systems which you can use at any time. For instance, you gain access to a casino, a football field, and a bar, and the area is infested with dozens of drunk and rambling random individuals you've never seen before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/e7f91eb9e37f66cd869c4a79b5813eba872e8a1c.jpg[/img]

[h3]So in conclusion, we have an area roughly half a square mile in size, where you can waste time at one of a dozen game mechanics. If that's enough, to meet the condition, then I have to admit that Booze Master is truly a sandbox.[/h3]

[i]For more information join our Discord server, or not... Don't care, love you anyway![/i]

notes.title: Burning Ambitions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/b1dcd10c672bb2d536f7936019a825b65d0ee7f3.png[/img]

Hello shatanists,

Probably many of you are wondering why we are not just releasing a demo. I've already written a post about our Heavy Duty benchmark, which you rated extremely high, thank you. But what is this benchmark all about?

We are not going to beat around the bush, Booze Master was meant to be a primitive simulator where you would experience the moonshine production process. There were supposed to be several dozen recipes for moonshine, simple interactions with village sellers, well-known flipper mechanics, an uncomplicated competition system... And that's it. Booze Master was supposed to be a cheap game that we'd make in a year. Sure, we planned a few twists, like police raids, but they were planned to function as a delicate ornament.

So what happened? Appetite grew with eating. Ambitions grew as skills grew.

- Do you put an NPC on the map? You want to talk to them, not just buy ingredients.
- Talk to the NPC? Why not prepare a decent storyline?
- Plot? Let's make a voiceovered mocument.
- Buy ingredients? And why not produce them yourself?
- Produce in your own enterprise? Let's add an expansion system.
- Why only moonshine? Let's add a beer.
- And wine.
- And more customers, with more demand.
- The world is big? Let's add means of transport...
- And skills.
- And the experience system.
- And let's balance these features so that they fit together.
- And that the core loop consisting in the execution of generated orders does not suffer.

See? It's becoming a sandbox. Just like Priest. That's how we do things, we like to go fucking crazy with features. You can accuse us of not being able to stick to the original plan and we will expand the game endlessly. The first part of the sentence is true, we like to discover the game as we develop it. But when our intuition tells us that it's good enough, it's good enough, and we decide not to add more "must have" cards to our Trello list. New ideas will go to "nice to have". And we're almost there.

The process was long and hard, but we've finally found our dev identity. Dense, intense sandbox mockumentaries are our way of making video games. Now everything will be easier. Moonshining will be fun.

We still have a bit of "must have" such as toboggan runs, drinking competitions, gambling, pub running, but there is some room for suggestions. If you have any ideas on what to fill the world with, let us know. We want and we have the skills to fulfill your whims.

ːVolgarrChaliceː
